Busy moms ages 30–60, if you feel like you’re doing everything right but the scale won’t move… this is probably why 👇

Most moms aren’t overeating junk — they’re undereating protein and choosing foods that look healthy but don’t support fat loss.

Look at this swap 👆
A granola bowl can easily hit 500+ calories, high carbs, high fats, and leaves you hungry again an hour later.

Now compare that to cottage cheese + fruit:
✔ fewer calories
✔ higher protein
✔ lower fat
✔ keeps you full longer

This is how fat loss actually starts to feel easier — not by cutting meals, but by making smarter swaps that work with your busy schedule.

If you’re a mom trying to lose 30–40 lbs and you don’t have time for extreme dieting, long workouts, or giving up foods you enjoy… this is the strategy that works.

Small choices like this, done consistently, add up fast.

👇 Moms ages 30–60: comment “WEIGHT LOSS” and I’ll send you my free fat-loss guide showing exactly how to build meals like this.

VKD Studio will be closed for the holidays from December 24 through January 5. ❤️
As the year comes to a close, we’re wishing you love, health, and inspiration—and extending our deepest gratitude to the clients and collaborators who made this year one to remember. Let’s keep it going in 2026! 🌟

I’ve been taking a moment to reflect on the past year, and honestly, I feel really grateful.

It took me to a lot of places and into rooms with people I truly respect, playing for @misbehave.live, @razorntape, @hothoneysundays, @needhelpmoving, @taketimenyc, and @casaclubrec, and sharing music in the U.S., the Dominican Republic, and Costa Rica.

I had only one release this year that I didn’t self-publish, on a label that bridged the Atlantic gap with @anxiety.therapy.bln, run by @javier.anxiety, who was extremely helpful and supportive of all my musical endeavors this year.

Somewhere in the middle of all that, I finally started @bitsofcorazon with the help of @laliitus. Not because everything was perfectly lined up, but because I didn’t want to keep waiting. I wanted to put the music out on my own terms. Lali was able to bring the visual identity to life. ❤️

I’m still juggling a full-time job at @proteinbakery, still doing this the working-class way. I’ve been DJing for close to 20 years now, and somehow the inspiration feels just as strong. Same love for the music, same curiosity, same pull toward the underground.

I’m thankful for every room, every dancefloor, and every person who’s shown up and listened.

So I’m curious — for 2026:

What NYC venues & parties do you want to see me in?
What like-minded U.S. cities should I be spending more time in?
And is there a country I haven’t been to yet where you think I would connect?

— ❤️ 🍉

As the year softens toward its close, I want to offer my thanks. Thank you to every person who trusted Soulful Soma with their body, their breath, and the quiet work of tending to themselves. The holidays often arrive carrying many layers at once. Celebration, grief, exhaustion, memory, hope. My wish is that this season gives you moments that feel steady and kind, moments where your body can exhale, even briefly. However you are moving through this time, you are allowed to go at your own pace. #mentalhealthawareness #mentalhealth #selfcare #fyp #foryoupage
